category_title: Students with blindness and autism exhibiting executive functioning deficits and low task independence
minimal_context: The student is attempting a reading comprehension task using a Braille book in a bustling school environment.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please open your Braille book and read the first page so we can answer the comprehension questions.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Runs hands over the edge of the book) The spiral binding on this book is distracting. And the paper makes too much sound when I turn it. I prefer audio books, because it is faster and easier to understand when you do not have to engage in tactile reading.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We need to use the paper book today. Go ahead and start reading.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: It's too noisy in the hallway. Nobody should shout, but speak in a low tone of voice and be quiet if the teacher says so. I don’t understand why students don’t do as the teacher says.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just try to ignore the noise and focus on understanding the story.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I can't concentrate on understanding what I am reading. The feel of certain letters is distracting, and with all this noise... If it’s not calm, sensible and quiet, I just cannot think!
